summary: Long-term capital gains other than those on listed shares and equity funds bought and sold with securities transaction tax are taxed at their own flat rate, apart from the rest of the income.

routes.name: The flat rate on the gains
routes.description: The gains are taxed at their own rate; the rest of the income at slab rates.

routes.name: Unused basic exemption set against the gains
routes.description: For a resident individual or Hindu undivided family, any part of the basic exemption the rest of the income does not use reduces these gains before they are taxed.

disqualifiers.description: Deductions from gross total income are not allowed against these gains; they are allowed only from the rest of the income.
Land or buildings bought before the rate change, where a resident individual or Hindu undivided family may pay the older rate with indexation instead.

enforcedBy.reason: no capital-gains input carries the kind of asset, and only equity is mapped from the portfolio

disqualifiers.description: Unlisted securities of a non-resident, whose gains are computed differently.

enforcedBy.reason: the gain is computed by the portfolio, and only equity is mapped
